    vertical_beam = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=start_x + 0.2,  # Right end of main beam
        y=start_y,
        width=0.4,
        height=3.0,
        density=5.0
    )

    # Pivot joint between main beam and vertical beam
    joint = sandbox.add_joint(
        main_beam, vertical_beam,
        anchor_point=(start_x + 0.2, start_y),  # At right end of main beam
        type='pivot',
        lower_limit=-math.pi,
        upper_limit=math.pi
    )

    # Pad placed at the top of the vertical beam (near the wall)
    pad = sandbox.add_pad(
        x=start_x + 0.2,  # Centered to the wall
        y=start_y + vertical_beam.height,  # At the top of the vertical beam
        radius=0.25,
        density=0.8
    )

    # Rigid joint between vertical beam and pad
    joint_pad = sandbox.add_joint(
        vertical_beam, pad,
        anchor_point=(start_x + 0.2, start_y + vertical_beam.height),
        type='rigid'
    )

    # Control parameters for agent action

        'cycle': 100,          # Phase cycle
        'overlap': 10,         # Overlap for phase transition
        'speed': 10.0,         # Motor speed (rad/s)
        'torque': 100.0,       # Motor torque (N·m)
        'p_torso': [pad],      # Pad used for adhesion
        'p_arm': [],           # No additional arms

        # Apply motor to climb
